strengths: Universal wake-up prank concept translates well to Royal Match humor
King Robert sleeping setup creates immediate visual clarity and comedic tension
Direct path to player interaction through stopping the alarm or clearing obstacles
concerns: Original trend depends on a specific viral audio track that must be replaced with game-appropriate audio
adaptation_idea: King Robert is sleeping peacefully on his throne when a mischievous royal parrot plays a loud, funny sound right in his ear. Players must quickly solve a match-3 puzzle to silence the sound and help King Robert wake up safely.
